items.briefing:
A new report from Proofpoint highlights that Australian CISOs are struggling with limited resources while managing growing AI-related security risks — a concern for any organisation adopting AI tools without adequate oversight. Separately, a critical vulnerability has been identified in Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source, meaning any Australian business running an online store on these platforms should apply security patches promptly. There is also an active Windows exploit called "ShieldCrash" circulating, which targets unpatched systems.

Attackers are also using voice calls to trick employees into connecting personal devices to Microsoft 365, potentially exposing corporate data — a reminder to be cautious about unsolicited calls requesting system access.

**Tip:** If you receive an unexpected call asking you to connect a personal device or grant system access, hang up and verify through official channels before doing anything.

featured.title: OpenSSL funds six Australian students for Prague conference
featured.summary: Six university students will gain rare access to global cryptography work as travel, hotel and registration costs are covered for Prague.
